changed.title: Worst conditional circuit error on a selector promise from fractional weights on affine cuts
changed.statement:
∀ k m r : ℕ,
  let n := k+2*m+r
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let F := ZMod 2
  let legal := fun (width : ℕ) (C : Circ) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack width C ∧
      (∀ h ∈ C.gates, h.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
        (h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or ∨ h.op = .mod 2 ∨ (h.op = .not ∧ h.inputs.length = 1)))
  let cost := fun (C : Circ) => C.gates.countP (fun h => @decide
    ((h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or) ∧ h.inputs.length = 2) (Classical.propDecidable _))
  let bits := fun (width : ℕ) (u : Fin width → F) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin width => decide (u j = 1))
  let V := Fin n → F
  let S := Fin k → F
  let D := Fin m → F
  let Z := Fin r → F
  let base := 2*m+r
  ∀ (e : V ≃ₗ[F] S × (D × (D × Z))) (A : Fin m → S) (h : S → F),
    let word := fun (s : S) (i : Fin m) => dotProduct (A i) s
    let score := fun (C : Circ) (s : S) =>
      (∑ x : V, ∑ b : D, ∑ c : D, ∑ z : Z,
        let y := e.symm (s,(b,(c,z)))
        let v := dotProduct x y + h s + ∑ i, word s i * b i * c i
        if C.eval (bits n x ++ bits n y) = decide (v = 1) then (1 : ℝ) else -1) / 2^(n+base)
    let fits := fun (p : ℕ) (C : Circ) => legal (2*n) C ∧ cost C ≤ p
    ∀ (E : Finset S) (a : S), a ∈ E →
      let W := Submodule.span F (Set.image (fun s : S => s-a) (↑E : Set S))
      let d := Module.finrank F W
      let varying := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter (fun i =>
        ∃ s ∈ E, word s i ≠ word a i)).card
      let price := base+d+varying
      let side := fun (l : S) (b : F) => E.filter (fun s => dotProduct l s ≠ b)
      let mass := fun (z : S → ℝ) (B : Finset S) => ∑ s ∈ B, z s
      let cover := fun (z : S → ℝ) => (∀ s ∈ E, 0 ≤ z s) ∧
        (∀ (l : S) (b : F), (side l b).Nonempty → side l b ≠ E → 1 ≤ mass z (side l b)) ∧
        ∀ (i : Fin m) (b : F), (side (A i) b).Nonempty → side (A i) b ≠ E →
          2 ≤ mass z (side (A i) b)
      let extension := ∃ (o : F) (l : S) (M : Fin k → Fin k → F), ∀ s ∈ E,
        h s = o + dotProduct l s + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * s i * s j
      0 < d → ∀ w : S → ℝ, (∀ s ∈ E, 0 < w s) →
        let total := fun (z : S → ℝ) => ∑ s ∈ E, w s * z s
        let feasible := fun (q : ℝ) =>
          ∃ (N : ℕ) (C : Fin N → Circ) (v : Fin N → ℝ),
            (∀ i, fits (price-1) (C i) ∧ 0 ≤ v i) ∧ (∑ i, v i) = 1 ∧
            ∀ s ∈ E, 1-(∑ i, v i * score (C i) s) ≤ q*w s
        ∃ z : S → ℝ, cover z ∧ 0 < total z ∧
          (∀ y : S → ℝ, cover y → total z ≤ total y) ∧
          (∀ q : ℝ, feasible q → 1 ≤ q * total z) ∧
          (extension → feasible (1 / total z) ∧
            (∀ p : ℕ, (∃ C : Circ, fits p C ∧ ∀ s ∈ E, score C s = 1) ↔ price ≤ p))

changed.context: A profile missing part of the promise loses a full affine cut side. One covering the promise must leave a varying column, losing half of one side. Cut the hull by a hyperplane or retain that column to realize these deficits when a quadratic fits the offset. A cover assigns each loss vector mass at least one. changed.title: Parity of shared controls tests the mean nonlinear fan-in-two gate bound for correlated pencils of arbitrary widths
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depths := fun (width : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate width 0)
let F := ZMod 2
∀ (q l : ℕ) (s : Fin l → ℕ),
  let V := Fin q → F
  let I := Σ i : Fin l, Fin (s i)
  let T := Matrix I I F
  let dot := fun (a z : V) => ∑ j, a j * z j
  ∀ (a b : Fin l → V), (∀ i, a i ≠ 0 ∧ b i ≠ 0 ∧ a i ≠ b i) →
    ∀ (U W : (i : Fin l) → Matrix (Fin (s i)) (Fin (s i)) F),
      (∀ i, (U i).rank = s i ∧ (W i).rank = s i ∧ (U i + W i).rank = s i) →
      ∀ S : Submodule F T, S = Submodule.span F {A : T | A ∈ S ∧ A.rank ≤ 2} →
        let line := fun i : Fin l => ({a i, b i, a i + b i} : Finset V)
        let lines := Finset.univ.image line
        let mass := fun H : Finset V => ∑ i, if line i = H then s i else 0
        let N := ∑ i, s i
        let free := Module.finrank F S
        let K := fun z : V =>
          Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => dot (a i) z • U i + dot (b i) z • W i)
        let w := Fintype.card (I ⊕ I)
        let coord := Fintype.equivFin (I ⊕ I)
        let table := fun (A : T) (z : V) (x y : Fin (w+1)) =>
          let X := Matrix.fromBlocks A (K z) (K z).transpose (0 : T)
          Fin.cases false (fun i => Fin.cases false (fun j =>
            decide (X (coord.symm i) (coord.symm j) ≠ 0)) y) x
        let bank := fun t : ℕ =>
          ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (tap : T → V → ℕ),
            PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack ((w+1)+(w+1)) C ∧
            (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ C.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ t ∧
            ∀ A ∈ S, ∀ z : V,
              (depths ((w+1)+(w+1)) C).getD (tap A z) 0 ≤ 1 ∧
              PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (table A z) ⟨C.gates, tap A z⟩
        let m := fun u : V => ∑ H ∈ lines, if u ∈ H then mass H else 0
        let odd := Finset.univ.filter (fun u : V => m u % 2 = 1)
        (∀ t : ℕ, bank t → free ≤ t ∧ 3*N ≤ 2*(t-free) ∧
          (2*(t-free) = 3*N → odd = ∅) ∧
          (2*(t-free) = 3*N+1 → ∃ H : Submodule F V,
            ∀ u : V, u ∈ odd ↔ u ≠ 0 ∧ u ∈ H)) ∧
          ∀ D : Finset (Finset V), D ⊆ lines → (∀ H ∈ D, 0 < mass H) →
            let left := Finset.univ.filter (fun u : V =>
              (m u + (D.filter (fun H => u ∈ H)).card) % 2 = 1)
            bank (free + (3*N + D.card + left.card)/2)

let header := fun n : Nat => List.replicate n true ++ [false]
let width := fun n : Nat => n.log2+1
let pack := fun (k : Nat) (rows : List (List Nat)) =>
  header k ++ rows.flatMap (fun row => row.flatMap (bits (width k)))
let well := fun (k : Nat) (rows : List (List Nat)) => ∀ row ∈ rows,
  row.length = 4 ∧ row.Nodup ∧ ∀ v ∈ row, v < k
let wins := fun (k : Nat) (rows : List (List Nat)) (P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) =>
  Function.Involutive P ∧ ∀ row ∈ rows, ∃ u : Fin k, u.val ∈ row ∧
    (P u).val ∈ row ∧ P u ≠ u
let lang : Language Bool := {x | ∃ k rows, well k rows ∧ pack k rows = x ∧
  ∃ P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), wins k rows P}
let witness := fun (k : Nat) (P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) =>
  (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i => bits (width k) (P i).val)
let R : Set (List Bool × List Bool) := {z | ∃ k rows, well k rows ∧ pack k rows = z.1 ∧
  ∃ P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), wins k rows P ∧ witness k P = z.2}
PEqualNP.Library.NPComplete lang ∧ PEqualNP.Library.PolyTimeReducible PEqualNP.Search.SAT lang ∧
  PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R ∧
  (∀ x w, (x,w) ∈ R → w.length ≤ (x.length+1)^2) ∧
  (∀ k rows, well k rows → ∃ E : {P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) // wins k rows P} ≃
    {w : List Bool // (pack k rows,w) ∈ R}, ∀ P, (E P).val = witness k P.val)

changed.title: Detecting a hidden period in cyclic sensor reports and ranking the original passing keys
changed.statement:
∀ (p n r d : Nat) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hd : 0 < d) (hn : d < n), 4 ≤ r →
  letI : ∀ P : Prop, Decidable P := Classical.propDecidable
  let k := p*n
  let D := 2^d
  let W := Fin (2^k)
  let Y := Fin (2^n)
  let rot := fun (h w : Nat) =>
    ((w <<< (h % k)) ||| (w >>> (k - h % k))) % 2^k
  let step := fun (w : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i => acc ||| ((xor (w.testBit i)
      (!(w.testBit ((i+1)%k)) && w.testBit ((i+2)%k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let state := fun (col : Bool) (w name : Nat) (c : Fin r → W) =>
    let b := if col then 2 else 1
    (List.finRange r).foldl (fun x j =>
      step (x ^^^ rot b x ^^^ rot (k-b) x) ^^^
        rot (if col then 3*(j.val+1)+1 else 2*j.val) w ^^^ (c j).val)
      (rot (if col then 3 else 1) w ^^^ name)
  let reach := fun col : Bool => if col then 7*r-2 else 5*r-3
  let delay := fun col : Bool => if col then 3*r+1 else 2*r-2
  let bits := fun (a x : Nat) => (List.range a).map (fun i => x.testBit i)
  let sched := fun (c : Fin r → W) => (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun j => bits k (c j).val)
  ∃ A C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo A ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (3*k+2*r*k+(k+1)+1) A ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (3*k+2*r*k+n+2*(k+1)+1) C ∧
    A.size ≤ 2^40*(k+r+D+5)^13 ∧
    C.size ≤ 2^60*(k+r+D+5)^28*((p+D^3).choose p) ∧
    ∀ (nr nc : W) (cr cc : Fin r → W) (bank : Fin k → Bool) (y : Y)
      (t : Fin (2^(k+1))) (j : Fin (k+1)) (countMode : Bool),
      let valid := ∀ i, reach (bank i) ≤ d
      let report := fun (w : Nat) (i : Fin n) => (List.finRange p).foldl (fun bit a =>
        let pos := a.val*n+i.val
        let col := bank ⟨pos % k, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_lt_succ 1) hp) (Nat.lt_trans hd hn))⟩
        xor bit ((state col w (if col then nc.val else nr.val)
          (if col then cc else cr)).testBit ((pos+delay col)%k))) false
      let good := fun g : W => ∀ w : W,
        report ((rot n w.val) ^^^ g.val) = report (w.val ^^^ g.val)
      let hit := fun w : W => ∀ i : Fin n, report w.val i = y.val.testBit i.val
      let cfg := bits k nr.val ++ bits k nc.val ++ sched cr ++ sched cc ++ List.ofFn bank
      (A.eval (cfg ++ bits (k+1) j.val ++ [countMode]) =
        decide (valid ∧ (if countMode then (Nat.card {g : W // good g}).testBit j.val = true
          else ∃ g : W, good g ∧ (∀ h : W, good h → g ≤ h) ∧
            (j.val = 0 ∨ g.val.testBit (j.val-1) = true)))) ∧
      (C.eval (cfg ++ bits n y.val ++ bits (k+1) t.val ++ bits (k+1) j.val ++ [countMode]) =
        decide (valid ∧ (∃ g : W, good g) ∧
          (if countMode then (Nat.card {w : W // hit w}).testBit j.val = true else
           ∃ w : W, hit w ∧ Nat.card {z : W // z < w ∧ hit z} = t.val ∧
             (j.val = 0 ∨ w.val.testBit (j.val-1) = true))))

changed.title: Counting pairings of triples with at most two occurrences per name modulo powers of two reduces to linear families
changed.statement:
let header := fun n : Nat => List.replicate n true ++ [false]
let bits := fun (w x : Nat) => (List.range w).map (fun i => x.testBit i)
∃ (f : List Bool → List Bool) (M : Turing.TM2ComputableAux Bool Bool) (C : Nat),
  (∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)) ∧
  ∀ (n t : Nat) (H : Finset (Finset (Fin n))), (∀ R ∈ H, R.card = 3) →
    (∀ u : Fin n, (H.filter (fun R => u ∈ R)).card ≤ 2) →
    let Rows := Finset (Finset (Fin n))
    let count := fun (U : Finset (Fin n)) (F : Rows) (s : Nat) =>
      Nat.card {N : Rows // (∀ g ∈ N, g.card = 2 ∧ g ⊆ U) ∧
        (∀ g ∈ N, ∀ h ∈ N, g ≠ h → Disjoint g h) ∧
        (∀ R ∈ F, ∃ g ∈ N, g ⊆ R) ∧ N.card = s}
    let shared := (H.product H).image (fun z => z.1 ∩ z.2)
    let cores := shared.filter (fun c => c.card = 2)
    let ordinary := Finset.univ \ cores.biUnion id
    let base := H.filter (fun R => R ⊆ ordinary)
    let outer := fun c : Finset (Fin n) => (H.filter (fun R => c ⊆ R)).biUnion id \ c
    let left := fun S : Rows => ordinary \ S.biUnion outer
    let reduced := fun S : Rows => base.image (fun R => R ∩ left S)
    let hist := fun s : Nat => count Finset.univ H s
    let encode := header n ++ header t ++ H.toList.flatMap
      (fun R => R.toList.flatMap (fun u => bits (n.log2+1) u.val))
    (∀ S ⊆ cores, ∀ R ∈ reduced S, ∀ T ∈ reduced S, R ≠ T → (R ∩ T).card ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ s : Nat, hist s % (2^t) =
      ((cores.powerset.filter (fun S => S.card < t ∧ (S.biUnion outer).card = 2*S.card ∧
        cores.card+S.card ≤ s)).sum (fun S =>
          2^S.card * count (left S) (reduced S) (s-cores.card-S.card))) % (2^t)) ∧
    f encode = (List.range (n/2+1)).flatMap (fun s => bits t (hist s)) ∧
    Nonempty (Turing.TM2OutputsInTime M.tm (encode.map M.inputAlphabet.invFun)
      (some ((f encode).map M.outputAlphabet.invFun)) ((encode.length+2)^(t+C)))

changed.context: Two triples sharing a pair exhaust both names and form an isolated conflict. Present shared pairs cost one pair each. Delete all private names and occupied endpoints, shrink the other triples, then count the remaining linear family by its incidence trees and cycles. Taking j absent pairs gives a factor 2^j, so enumerate only j<t and accumulate size coefficients modulo 2^t.

changed.title: Quadratic test lists certify regular-target decoder loss, and smaller lists admit fair OR-only counterexamples
changed.statement:
∀ N t : ℕ, N < 2*t → t < N →
  let X := Fin N
  let L := 2*N*(N-1)
  let graph := X → X → Bool
  let reg := fun (T : graph) =>
    (∀ x, (Finset.univ.filter (fun y => T x y)).card = t) ∧
    (∀ y, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => T x y)).card = t)
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let tab := fun (C : Circ) (x y : X) => C.eval (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach x y)
  let area := fun (C : Circ) => ((Finset.univ : Finset (X × X)).filter (fun z => tab C z.1 z.2)).card
  let loss := fun (C : Circ) (T : graph) => ((Finset.univ : Finset (X × X)).filter
    (fun z => tab C z.1 z.2 ≠ T z.1 z.2)).card
  ∃ test : Fin L → graph, (∀ i, reg (test i)) ∧
    ∀ (g r s : ℕ), 0 < r → r ≤ s → r+s = g+1 → r*s < N → 2*g+1 < N →
      let A := (g+1)*N-r*s
      let a := 2*t-N
      let V := ((N*t : ℕ) : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)*(A : ℝ)/(N : ℝ)
      let fits := fun (C : Circ) =>
        PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N+N) C ∧ C.output < N+N+C.size ∧
        (∀ gate ∈ C.gates, gate.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
          (gate.op = .or ∨ gate.op = .and ∨ (gate.op = .not ∧ gate.inputs.length = 1))) ∧
        C.size ≤ g ∧ area C ≤ A
      let lines := fun (C : Circ) => ∃ R S : Finset X, R.card+S.card = g+1 ∧
        ∀ x y, tab C x y = decide (x ∈ R ∨ y ∈ S)
      let c := Nat.gcd (N / Nat.gcd N r) (N / Nat.gcd N s)
      (∀ (M : ℕ) (D : Fin M → Circ) (w : Fin M → ℝ) (h : ℝ),
        (∀ i, fits (D i) ∧ 0 ≤ w i) → (∑ i, w i) = 1 → 0 ≤ h →
        let err := fun T => ∑ i, w i*(loss (D i) T : ℝ)
        (∀ j, err (test j) ≤ V+h) →
          (∀ T, reg T → err T ≤ V+(((N-1)*t*(N-t) : ℕ) : ℝ)*h) ∧
          (a : ℝ)*((N-r*s : ℕ) : ℝ)*
            (∑ i, @ite ℝ (lines (D i)) (Classical.propDecidable _) 0 (w i)) ≤ (N : ℝ)*h) ∧
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (Q : Fin m → graph), m ≤ (N-1)^2 → (∀ j, reg (Q j)) →
        ∃ (M : ℕ) (D : Fin M → Circ), 0 < M ∧
          ((∃ u : ℕ, c = 2^u) → ∃ u : ℕ, M = 2^u) ∧
          (∀ i, fits (D i) ∧ area (D i) = A ∧ ∀ gate ∈ (D i).gates, gate.op = .or) ∧
          (∀ j, (∑ i, (loss (D i) (Q j) : ℝ)) ≤ (M : ℝ)*V) ∧
          ∃ T, reg T ∧ (M : ℝ)*V < ∑ i, (loss (D i) T : ℝ)
